all_elements.text: I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?
Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

all_elements.speaker: JULIANA
all_elements.text: Knowledge. Love. And people who need me.
Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

all_elements.speaker: CATHERINE
all_elements.text: [scoffs] Peasants? People?
Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.

all_elements.speaker: CATHERINE
all_elements.text: That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve.
Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.

all_elements.speaker: JULIANA
all_elements.text: Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?
Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.

all_elements.speaker: JULIANA
all_elements.text: If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow.
Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.

all_elements.speaker: CATHERINE
all_elements.text: Enough!
Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.
Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.

all_elements.speaker: CATHERINE
all_elements.text: This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother.
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.

all_elements.speaker: JULIANA
all_elements.text: [gasping] Give it back!
Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.

all_elements.speaker: CATHERINE
all_elements.text: There. Finally. Something still hurts you.
Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.

all_elements.speaker: JULIANA
all_elements.text: No!
Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.

all_elements.speaker: CATHERINE
all_elements.text: One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash.
Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.

Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.

logline: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 31's cliffhanger where Catherine used a glowing branding iron to scorch Juliana's mother's herbal book.

elements.text: Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.
Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.
Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: There it is.
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: Fear.
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: You have been so proud of that brave little face...
Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: ...but now you are afraid.
Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: Say goodbye to your mother.
Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Burn it.
Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: What?
Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Burn the ledger. Burn every page.
Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: You may destroy the book...
Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: ...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me.
Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: You think a few herbs make you better than me?
Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: No. Your cruelty does that for me.
High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: You still think you are better?!
Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: I know what I am.
Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: A disgraced woman?
Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me.
Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: You are lying!
Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me.
Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him.
Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Let him have Clarissa.
Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: He lost me.
Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: You were rejected!
Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.
Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: Your soldier?
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: My husband.
Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: He is a nobody.
Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Then I love a nobody.
Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.
Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: You know nothing about my world.
Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: I know exactly what your world values.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Beauty. Money.
Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Family. A perfect name.
Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.
Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: And what is wrong with that?!
Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
Close-up of Juliana looking serene.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.
Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...
Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: ...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you.
Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: Silence! Silence!
Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: Why?!
Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Because I am right!
Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: You want everyone to believe you are powerful.
Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: You want everyone to fear you.
Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: But look at you.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!
Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: You insolent—!
Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: You may have the title you have always wanted...
Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: ...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else.
Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: You think you can lecture me?!
Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.
Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!
Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.
Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.

logline: Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.
continuity_notes: Following Catherine's dungeon interrogation of Juliana, the conspiracy against Juliana deepens as an aristocratic lord forces a testimony of witchcraft out of the young maid whose brother Juliana saved.

elements.text: Wide shot of a dimly lit, wood-paneled library study. An aristocratic lord in formal dark attire stands facing a young maid standing nervously by the open door.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Your brother is breathing again.
The young maid steps inside, bowing with a submissive curtsy, keeping her head low and hands clasped.
Medium close-up of the maid trembling as she raises her eyes hesitantly.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: Yes, my Lord.
Medium shot of the Lord standing beside his mahogany desk, looking down with cold, calculating scrutiny.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: And who saved him?
Close-up of the maid's anxious, innocent face.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: Lady Juliana.
Close-up of the Lord's hand slowly rotating the heavy gold signet ring on his pinky finger.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Tell me how.
Medium close-up of the maid nervously wringing her apron fabric.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: She... she used herbs.
Close-up on the Lord leaning forward abruptly, his piercing gaze bearing down.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: What herbs?
Close-up of the frightened maid looking down, shrinking back.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: I don't know.
Low-angle shot looking up at the imposing Lord towering above her.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: You watched her.
Close-up of the maid, tears beginning to glisten on her cheeks as she defends Juliana.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: I watched her save him.
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning away slowly past the lamp-lit desk toward the rain-streaked window.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: That is not what I asked.
Medium two-shot framing the maid from behind as the Lord steps back toward her with commanding stillness.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Did she use her mother's book?
Close-up of the maid trembling, tears spilling down her face.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord's sinister, unyielding face.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?
Medium shot of the maid clutching her hands together tightly, overwhelmed with guilt.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord's mouth curling into a sinister, predatory smile.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: And did she perform anything unusual?
Close-up of the maid gasping, shaking her head vigorously in panic.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: No!
Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Think carefully.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Your brother is still a pauper.
Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.
The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: Please, my Lord... he is only seven!
Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Then help him.
Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: What do you want me to say?!
Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: The truth.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?
Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.
Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Around him.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Like a circle?

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: Yes.
Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: And she opened her mother's book...
Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: ...and spoke words you could not understand.
Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: She was praying!
Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Praying... or chanting?
Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: I don't know!
Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: You saw her use a forbidden book.
Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: You heard words you could not understand.
Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: That is witchcraft.
Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!
Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: That will be your testimony.
Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: My testimony?!
Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Before the magistrate.
Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: I never said she was a witch!
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: You do not need to.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: I have already written the story for you.
Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: She saved my brother...
Close-up of the Lord turning back, resting one hand upon the desk with cold finality.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: And now... you will save your brother.
The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.
High angle looking down as the maid falls prostrate on the floor.

elements.speaker: MAID
elements.text: I am sorry, Lady Juliana...
Low-angle shot of the Lord looking down dismissively at the prostrate maid.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Save your tears for the trial.
Side medium shot of the maid kneeling crumpled on the floor in the dimly lit study, her face buried in both hands, weeping uncontrollably as the scene slowly fades into the dark silence.
The heartbroken maid weeps silently in the shadow of the desk, consumed by guilt and powerlessness.

all_elements.text: Wide shot of a dimly lit, wood-paneled library study. An aristocratic lord in formal dark attire stands facing a young maid standing nervously by the open door.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Your brother is breathing again.
The young maid steps inside, bowing with a submissive curtsy, keeping her head low and hands clasped.
Medium close-up of the maid trembling as she raises her eyes hesitantly.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: Yes, my Lord.
Medium shot of the Lord standing beside his mahogany desk, looking down with cold, calculating scrutiny.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: And who saved him?
Close-up of the maid's anxious, innocent face.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: Lady Juliana.
Close-up of the Lord's hand slowly rotating the heavy gold signet ring on his pinky finger.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Tell me how.
Medium close-up of the maid nervously wringing her apron fabric.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: She... she used herbs.
Close-up on the Lord leaning forward abruptly, his piercing gaze bearing down.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: What herbs?
Close-up of the frightened maid looking down, shrinking back.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: I don't know.
Low-angle shot looking up at the imposing Lord towering above her.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: You watched her.
Close-up of the maid, tears beginning to glisten on her cheeks as she defends Juliana.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: I watched her save him.
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning away slowly past the lamp-lit desk toward the rain-streaked window.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: That is not what I asked.
Medium two-shot framing the maid from behind as the Lord steps back toward her with commanding stillness.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Did she use her mother's book?
Close-up of the maid trembling, tears spilling down her face.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord's sinister, unyielding face.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?
Medium shot of the maid clutching her hands together tightly, overwhelmed with guilt.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord's mouth curling into a sinister, predatory smile.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: And did she perform anything unusual?
Close-up of the maid gasping, shaking her head vigorously in panic.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: No!
Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Think carefully.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Your brother is still a pauper.
Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.
The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: Please, my Lord... he is only seven!
Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Then help him.
Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: What do you want me to say?!
Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: The truth.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?
Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.
Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Around him.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Like a circle?

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: Yes.
Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: And she opened her mother's book...
Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: ...and spoke words you could not understand.
Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: She was praying!
Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Praying... or chanting?
Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: I don't know!
Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: You saw her use a forbidden book.
Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: You heard words you could not understand.
Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: That is witchcraft.
Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!
Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: That will be your testimony.
Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: My testimony?!
Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: Before the magistrate.
Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: I never said she was a witch!
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: You do not need to.

all_elements.speaker: LORD
all_elements.text: I have already written the story for you.
Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.

all_elements.speaker: MAID
all_elements.text: She saved my brother...

logline: Put on trial for witchcraft and poisoning, Lady Juliana stands proud and defiant in the prisoner's dock, refusing to renounce her mother's herbal medicine even after her coerced maid gives false testimony against her.
continuity_notes: Following the aristocratic Lord's ruthless extortion of the young maid in his study, Episode 34 transitions directly into the crowded courtroom trial where the conspirators unleash their manufactured charges and false witnesses against Lady Juliana.

elements.text: High wide establishing shot from behind the presiding judge looking down into the grand, sunlit courtroom filled with stern spectators, armed bailiffs, and Lady Juliana standing confined in the wooden prisoner's dock on the left.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning.
Medium close-up of the stern, elderly Judge seated at the high mahogany bench, resting both hands on the court documents.
Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.
[A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Do you deny possessing this book?
Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: No.
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Do you deny using its remedies?
Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: No.
Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.
Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: I admit to healing the sick.
The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Silence!
[Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.
Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Prudence. You served beside the accused?
Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.
Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.

elements.speaker: PRUDENCE
elements.text: Yes, Your Honor.
Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?
Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: Tell the truth.
Close-up of Prudence breaking down in tears, squeezing her eyes shut as guilt overwhelms her.

elements.speaker: PRUDENCE
elements.text: Yes.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.
Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: What did you see?
Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.

elements.speaker: PRUDENCE
elements.text: She used herbs... and her mother's book.
Medium shot of the Judge leaning back slightly, pointing his hand accusingly.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Did she draw strange markings?
Close-up of Prudence's tear-streaked face as she hesitates, her breath hitching.

elements.speaker: PRUDENCE
elements.text: She... placed herbs around my brother's bed.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: And did she speak words you could not understand?
Extreme close-up of Prudence weeping uncontrollably, her face contorted in unbearable remorse.

elements.speaker: PRUDENCE
elements.text: Yes.
Medium tracking shot of the Lord stepping into the open aisle of the courtroom with arms spread wide, turning triumphantly toward the Judge.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual.
Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: It was not a ritual!
The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.
[Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: You will speak when addressed!
Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: We have further witnesses.
Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.

elements.speaker: TOWNSMAN
elements.text: My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures...
Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: And?
Close-up of the townsman's face tightening with coached distress.

elements.speaker: TOWNSMAN
elements.text: She became violently ill.
Medium shot among the spectators as an elderly peasant woman stands up from the wooden bench, pointing an accusatory finger across the courtroom.

elements.speaker: OLD WOMAN
elements.text: My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!
Side two-shot of the Lord stepping up to the dock, looming beside Lady Juliana as she looks him in the eye.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: She calls it healing.
The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.
Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: The people call it poisoning!
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: What were their illnesses?
Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Irrelevant.
Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: It is not irrelevant!
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!
Medium shot of the Judge sitting with steepled fingers upon his high bench.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: You admit you administered them?
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking straight forward.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: Yes.
Medium shot of the Judge gesturing with an open hand.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Without the approval of a licensed physician?
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana shaking her head slightly, truth ringing in her voice.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: There was no physician willing to help them.
Close-up of Lady Juliana's steady gaze.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: So I helped them.
Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.

elements.speaker: LORD
elements.text: Even now, she refuses to repent.
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices.
Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.
Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: No.
Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Think carefully.
Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: I have.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?
Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: Then let it be.
Medium shot of Prudence breaking into shattered sobs, pressing her apron to her face to muffle her tears.
Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.
Medium shot pushing into Lady Juliana's face as she speaks directly across the hall with compassionate, unwavering authority.

elements.speaker: LADY JULIANA
elements.text: Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it.
Medium close-up profile of the Lord, his smirk instantly freezing into an irritated, malevolent scowl.
The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.
Close-up of the Judge slamming the wooden gavel down.
[Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Enough!
The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.
Low-angle medium shot looking up at the imposing Judge as he stands formally to deliver the judgment.

elements.speaker: JUDGE
elements.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft...

Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lady Juliana in the prisoner's dock looking toward the Judge, who solemnly raises his right hand to pronounce the final sentence as the heavy silence hangs over the courtroom.
The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

logline: Fleeing her captivity through a secret passage, Alexander's elderly mother treks through a bitter blizzard to a secluded cabin, where she tearfully reunites with her presumed-dead son and learns the horrifying conspiracy behind his supposed demise.
continuity_notes: While Juliana faces trial and sentencing in the courtroom, this episode reveals Alexander's mother escaping confinement and tracking down Alexander in his mountain hideout, uncovering the dark treason that orchestrates both their fates.

elements.text: Medium tracking shot following an elderly hooded woman clutching an iron lantern as she stumbles anxiously through a damp subterranean stone tunnel.
Alexander's mother, frail with silver hair under a dark hooded cloak, braces her hand against the rough stone wall, panting heavily in fear.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: I will not die in that house.
Close-up on her trembling, weathered hands gripping a mossy stone bolt set into a heavy iron plate on the stone wall.
She uses all her strength to shove the stone bolt upward, disengaging the hidden lock mechanism.
Heavy stone grating and metallic latch clanging as the lock releases.
The heavy stone doorway swings inward, and the elderly woman ducks low, crawling through the opening into the cold night outside.
Wide atmospheric shot of a deep, snow-covered pine forest at night. In the distance stands a small secluded log cabin nestled under towering snowy trees.
Alexander's mother plods through the thick snow, leaning heavily on a wooden walking stick, her dark cloak dusted with snow.
Howling winter wind and crunching of footsteps in deep snow.
Medium close-up of Alexander's mother arriving beside the frosted wooden door frame under sharp hanging icicles, shivering violently from the freezing cold.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: This must be the place.
Close-up on her wool-gloved hand unlatching the icy wooden door handle and pushing it open.
Creak of cold wooden hinges opening.
Panning shot from the open doorway revealing the warm, dimly lit cabin interior, settling on Alexander standing over a rustic wooden table by lantern light.
Alexander, wearing a rugged trench coat, his scarred face framed by long dark hair, stands studying an unfolded tactical map before snapping his head up in alarm.
Medium shot of Alexander's mother stepping across the threshold, holding up her burning lantern, her eyes wide with shock.
Extreme close-up on Alexander's scarred left cheek and wide, disbelieving blue eyes.
Close-up on his mother's tear-streaked face as her chin trembles and tears spill down her cheeks.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Alexander!
Close-up on Alexander as his hard expression crumbles into utter astonishment.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Mother?
She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: You're alive.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Mother.
She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: I buried you.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: I know.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed.
Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Most of them were.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Then how did you survive?
Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: I wasn't supposed to.
Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front.
Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies.
Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: A traitor?

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Yes.
Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: We were close to finding him.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Then came the ambush.
Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: My men were slaughtered.
Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: And you?

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: I was shot. Left for dead.
Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: How did you escape?
Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.
Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Then why did they never tell us?
Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Who?
Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: I spent three years trying to find out.
Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: The ambush was not an accident.
He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Someone ordered my men to die.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Someone wanted me erased.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Who?
Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, grim visage, his voice dropping to a deadly chill.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.
Close-up on his mother's face as the horrifying realization hits her, her mouth open in a soundless gasp of sheer dread as the scene holds and slowly fades.
A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.

logline: Learning from his mother that Rupert and Catherine framed Juliana for witchcraft and sentenced her to death right after their upcoming wedding, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything stolen from him.
continuity_notes: Picking up immediately from the revelation in Episode 35 that the men ruling Ashwood orchestrated Alexander's ambush, Alexander learns of Juliana's imprisonment and looming execution.

elements.text: Medium two-shot across the weathered wooden table lit by the warm glow of an oil lantern, framing Alexander and his mother leaning inward in the dimly lit cabin.
Alexander's mother leans forward with both hands on the rustic table, searching her son's scarred face in disbelief.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Then why did they never find you?
Close-up on Alexander, his dark combat scar prominent as his eyes burn with steady, cold intensity.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Because they made certain no one would look.
Medium close-up on Alexander's mother, her hood framing her pale, weathered face as shock deepens across her features.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Who?
Side profile shot of Alexander gazing toward the open doorway before slowly turning back to face his mother directly.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Sterling... and Rupert.
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother as her breath hitches and her eyes widen in pure horror.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Rupert?
Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: They knew where I was.
Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered.
Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: They gave you to the enemy?
Medium close-up of Alexander straightening his posture, his jaw set hard.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: They gave them my location.
Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: They wanted the investigation buried.
Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: And when you disappeared...?
Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: They declared me dead.
Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: They falsified what remained of the reports.
Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.
Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: And Rupert took Ashbourne.
Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: While the world mourned a dead heir.
Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: And I mourned you.
Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: I know.
Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: I trusted them.
Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: You trusted family.
Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: They used that trust against you.
Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Mother... Juliana...
Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back.
Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: I thought perhaps she stayed with you.
Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Alexander...
Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: What?
Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: She did come to me.
Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Is she still at Ashbourne?
Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: No...
Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Then where is she?
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: They arrested her!
Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Arrested?
Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!
Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: But she saved you!
Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: I told them!
Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: You told them the truth!
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: They called her a witch!
Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Juliana... is in a cell?
Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: She was taken before a magistrate.
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: And?!
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: They condemned her.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: No.
Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: She is to be executed.
Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: When?
Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: What wedding?
Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Rupert... and Catherine's.
A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Two days from now.
Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: They are marrying in two days...
Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.
Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
elements.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!
Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: They already took my name.
Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: They stole my home!
Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: And now they have taken Juliana!
Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.
Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Two days.
Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.
Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: Because before that wedding begins...
Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.

elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
elements.text: ...their dead Duke is coming home.
Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.
A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: No...
Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: Then where is she?
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: They arrested her!
Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: Arrested?
Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!
Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: But she saved you!
Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: I told them!
Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: You told them the truth!
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: They called her a witch!
Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: Juliana... is in a cell?
Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: She was taken before a magistrate.
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: And?!
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: They condemned her.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: No.
Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: She is to be executed.
Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: When?
Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: What wedding?
Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: Rupert... and Catherine's.
A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: Two days from now.
Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: They are marrying in two days...
Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.
Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
all_elements.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!
Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: They already took my name.
Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: They stole my home!
Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: And now they have taken Juliana!
Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.
Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: Two days.
Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.
Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: Because before that wedding begins...
Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.

all_elements.speaker: ALEXANDER
all_elements.text: ...their dead Duke is coming home.
Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.
A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.

logline: As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's public execution decree to terrorize the county, Juliana endures starvation in the dungeon, refusing to break her spirit.
continuity_notes: Following Alexander's vow to return in two days to disrupt the wedding, Rupert and Catherine prepare to cement their coup by inviting high society to celebrate their nuptials and witness Juliana's execution.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBRIDGE MANOR - GRAND CORRIDOR – DAY

elements.text: Low-angle shot tilting down to a polished mahogany table as a white-gloved servant places a tall stack of wax-sealed wedding invitations onto a silver tray.
The crisp tap of heavy cardstock envelopes being set down onto silver.
Medium two-shot framed symmetrically down the vaulted, sunlit hallway. Blond Nobleman Rupert stands tall in a black embroidered frock coat, facing Catherine in an ornate pink gown.

elements.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
elements.text: Every important family in the county should witness it.
Close-up of Catherine looking down at the invitations, her braided blonde hair immaculately pinned, before she raises her eyes with a slight smirk.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: The wedding?
Close-up on Rupert, his sharp aristocratic features set in cold conviction.

elements.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
elements.text: The transfer of Ashbridge.
Medium close-up of Catherine picking up one of the invitations, turning it over in her gloved hands with predatory delight.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house.
Intense close-up of Rupert leaning in slightly, his eyes narrowing with venomous malice.

elements.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
elements.text: And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us.
Tight close-up of Catherine as a cruel sneer twists her lips.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.
Wide shot framing the two conspirators beneath the towering archways of the estate.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests.
Medium close-up of Rupert turning his gaze toward the grand entrance.

elements.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
elements.text: Send the invitations.
Close-up of Catherine looking sideways with narrowed eyes.

elements.speaker: CATHERINE
elements.text: Especially to the Ashcrofts.
Wide tracking shot down a palatial marble hall as a butler carries a silver tray toward double doors.
Medium shot inside an opulent drawing room with a roaring fireplace. Lady Clarissa sits gracefully in an emerald satin gown as the butler presents the tray.

elements.speaker: BUTLER
elements.text: Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor.
Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.
Close-up of Clarissa's face lighting up with malicious excitement, the warm hearth flickering in the background.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: Catherine's wedding.
Medium two-shot as her dark-haired husband steps up behind her chair, crossing his arms.

elements.speaker: NOBLEMAN
elements.text: So it is finally official.
Close-up of Clarissa smiling down at the calligraphy.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: Lady Catherine Ashbridge.
Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: And after the ceremony...

elements.speaker: NOBLEMAN
elements.text: What?
Clarissa hands the letter upward to him. He takes it and looks down at the bold heading.
Close-up of the nobleman reading, his eyes widening in shock before breaking into a grin.

elements.speaker: NOBLEMAN
elements.text: The sentencing of the condemned.
Close-up of Clarissa turning back to the fire, laughing softly with dark delight.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: They want the families to witness it.
Medium shot of the nobleman holding the invitation, chuckling at the audacity.

elements.speaker: NOBLEMAN
elements.text: A public execution after a wedding.
Medium profile shot of Clarissa gazing back at him over her shoulder.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: Not just an execution. A warning.
Close-up of the nobleman's stern face, leaning down.

elements.speaker: NOBLEMAN
elements.text: To whom?
Close-up on Clarissa taking the letter back into her gloved fingers, her eyes gleaming with aristocratic cruelty.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given.
Wide shot of the parlor as Clarissa tosses the invitation dismissively onto the side table and looks directly toward the viewer.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch.

Wide, dim shot of the subterranean stone dungeon. Juliana sits slumped against a weeping stone wall on the wet floor, dressed in a tattered prison smock, illuminated only by faint overhead moonlight piercing a ceiling grate.
Rhythmic water drips splashing onto stagnant dungeon puddles and a low, mournful ambient drone.
Close-up on Juliana's bruised hand, locked in a heavy iron shackle chained to the wall, trembling as she hesitates inches away from a dirty earthen bowl filled with murky liquid.
Juliana curls her fingers back, pulling away from the foul sustenance in defiance.
Tight close-up of Juliana's dirty, tear-stained face. Her eyes squeeze shut as tears stream down her cheeks from overwhelming physical agony and hunger.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: They think hunger will make me surrender.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's blue eyes snapping open, blazing with unyielding defiance.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: They think fear will make me beg.
Full shot of Juliana using her bare hands against the slimy stone floor to drag herself upright to her knees, chains rattling loudly.
The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: I will not!
Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana as she thrusts her chin high toward the iron ceiling grate, bathed in cold shafts of light.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: They can take my name. They can take my home.
Tight close-up of Juliana's iron-shackled hand reaching out and gripping the massive iron ring anchored into the dungeon pillar with crushing determination.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: They cannot take who I am!
Medium two-shot in the dimly lit parlor, illuminated by the warm glow of the fireplace. Clarissa now wears a deep blue velvet gown, reclining in an armchair beside the nobleman.

elements.speaker: NOBLEMAN
elements.text: Do you think she'll actually be executed?
Close-up of Clarissa giving a slight, dismissive scoff before turning to him with cold certainty.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: After what she has been accused of? Of course.
Medium close-up of the nobleman looking down pensively at the open execution clause on the table.

elements.speaker: NOBLEMAN
elements.text: She was always stubborn.
Close-up on Clarissa's face hardening with bitter resentment.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly.
Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.
Medium tracking shot showing Clarissa standing tall beside her husband, her posture regal and vindictive.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it.
Tight close-up on Clarissa's face glowing in the firelight. Her lips curl into a merciless smile as she lifts the crystal glass to her mouth and drinks.

elements.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
elements.text: Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place.
Clarissa takes a slow sip of the red wine, her eyes gleaming with dark relish.

Slow push-in on the dark polished tabletop where the open invitation lies beside the wax seal. The bold Gothic lettering "EXECUTION CLAUSE" sits beneath the gold crest, while the fire dances reflected on the mahogany.
A deep, ominous cello rumble builds alongside the crackle of the fireplace into an unresolved, tension-filled cliffhanger sting before fading out.

logline: A compassionate guard secretly feeds Juliana bread in the dungeon, strengthening her resolve to protect Alexander's secrets just as distant wedding bells signal the start of Rupert's nuptials and her impending execution.
continuity_notes: Following Rupert and Catherine's cruel announcement pairing their wedding with Juliana's public execution, Juliana remains starved in the subterranean dungeon awaiting her fate.

elements.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana slumped on the damp stone floor of her dark dungeon cell, her wrists bound in heavy iron shackles and chains draped over her lap.
Juliana sits motionless against the cold masonry, weak and visibly drained from starvation, her eyes cast downward.
Echoing, heavy bootsteps approach down the corridor outside the cell.
Tight close-up on Juliana's profile as her head turns toward the corridor, her blue eyes widening with cautious alarm.
Juliana blinks, lifting her gaze toward the heavy iron bars.
Medium shot through the cell bars as a Guard in a black collared uniform with silver buttons halts outside.
The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.
Low-angle shot focusing on the wet flagstones at the base of the cell door.
The Guard kneels down and slips a small loaf of rustic bread through the bottom gap between the iron bars, nudging it inside before withdrawing his gloved hand.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling forward across the stone floor toward the bread, her gaze fixed on the offering in disbelief.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Why?
Medium close-up of the Guard looking through the vertical bars with quiet compassion.

elements.speaker: GUARD
elements.text: Because no one should die hungry.

elements.speaker: GUARD
elements.text: Eat it before they see.
Over-the-shoulder shot through the cell bars as the Guard turns and walks swiftly away into the dark corridor.
The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.
Tight shot following Juliana's trembling, shackle-bound hands as she reaches out and drags the loaf toward her chest.
Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Thank you.
Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.
Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.
Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Alexander...
Low-angle wide shot of Juliana seated against the damp stone wall beneath high overhead iron ceiling grates, clutching the half-eaten bread in her lap.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: ...are you safe?
Intimate close-up of Juliana looking upward, her tear-stained face filled with raw anguish.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Do you even know what happened to me?

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Do you know they condemned me?
Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: What if I die here?

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: What if I never see you again?
A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.
Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Keep him safe.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Wherever he is.
Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Let him live.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: And if I have only one thing left to give...
Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: I will not give them my husband.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: I will not betray him.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's closed eyelids as she takes a sharp, startled breath.
Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.
Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Bells.
Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.
Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.
Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: The wedding.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: It's beginning.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Then I suppose I'm next.
Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.
Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.

elements.speaker: JULIANA
elements.text: Alexander...
Dramatic cut to black.
A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.
